email.subject: Re: Renewal Request - Summit Ridge Construction Inc. Policy CPP-6612078
email.body:
Hi Megan,

Please proceed with the renewal review for Summit Ridge Construction Inc., policy CPP-6612078, which is approaching expiration on 09/01/2026. We would like to renew coverage effective 09/01/2026 with no lapse in protection.

Please send over the renewal quote, updated terms, and any underwriting questions you may have. Let us know if you need loss runs, updated payroll or revenue figures, or project schedule details.

Thank you,
Derek Olsson
Summit Ridge Construction Inc.

On Wed, Jul 1, 2026 11:47 AM, Megan Hart <newbusiness@frontrangeins.com> wrote:
> Thanks for sending this over — can you confirm the requested effective date and whether any additional insureds are needed?

> Regards,
